description: This file defines the 'NationalityMenuConfigurator' class within the 'OrangeHRM' project. It implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and configures a menu item for the nationality screen within the HRM system. The class utilizes traits for module screen helper functions and overrides the current screen to 'nationality'.

classes.name: NationalityMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu for the nationality screen in the HRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'nationality' and returns null.
